summary: Exact candidate 3a1c517 fixes the independently reproduced delayed final-prefill token/metadata commit, optimistic-decode admission, and beam commit ordering in deterministic tests. It does not test or independently verify the original issue's negative scheduler output_ids contract, so it is a partial fix with an overbroad full-fix claim.
remaining_counterexamples: The original workload reports persistent negative scheduler output_ids after cancellation, but no candidate regression inspects schedule_batch or schedule_batch_post_run output_ids and this symptom was not reproduced or ruled out on the candidate.

The exact meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct plus RTX 4090/CUDA serving workload could not be executed in the assigned AMD gfx950/ROCm environment, so end-to-end absence of the visible token and negative-ID ladder remains unverified.

tests.command: candidate issue-specific tests copied onto the recorded base
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at delayed-result and optimistic-decode boundaries: all three tests failed; the cancelled request committed output/metadata and remained schedulable.
On exact candidate 3a1c517: 23 passed and 2 subtests passed, covering its regressions and adjacent result-processing paths, but not scheduler-record negative output IDs.

tests.command: py_compile changed Python files and git diff --check recorded-base exact-candidate
tests.what_was_measured: Changed Python files compile and the exact candidate diff has no whitespace errors.
Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 used one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 and produced tensor_sum=5.0; environment evidence only.

remaining_limitations: The reported model weights and NVIDIA RTX 4090/CUDA environment were unavailable.
The original HTTP/action-plan workload and its negative scheduler output_ids observation were not rerun on the candidate.
The available tiny Llama fixture validates transport and engine execution only and cannot qualify the original model/workload contract, so it was not substituted as proof.
GPU execution was an environment probe; the issue-specific regressions were CPU control-flow fixtures.
No native files changed and repository-environment.json records native=null, so no native rebuild was applicable.
